text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper's primary focus is on developing and applying an index of ecological integrity (IEI) and an index of ecological impact (ecoImpact) for conservation assessment and planning. While it uses future land use scenarios (urban growth projections) as an input to calculate ecoImpact, the core research is not about predicting or simulating LULC change. The LULC projections are generated by a separate model (SPRAWL) and used incidentally to assess ecological impacts. The paper does not implement or validate LULC prediction models, nor does it report quantitative accuracy metrics for LULC projections. The scale is regional (northeastern US), not national-scale.)
